claim_boundary: Stage 22.6 closes numeric inversion proxy attribution for the Stage 22.4 row contract. It does not claim a full semantic inversion theorem; scores are runtime structural proxies derived without gold labels.

inversion_scan_gate.boundary: Scores are deterministic runtime inversion-risk proxies derived from readout disagreement, trace instability, register/drive/foundation concentration, and RPM factor recomposition. They are not gold-label correctness and not a full semantic inversion theorem.
